```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Load Packages
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(countrycode)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
# Read Data
gii <- read.csv(
  "HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv",
  fileEncoding = "Latin1")

world <- st_read(
  "World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson")
```
```{r, include=FALSE}
names(gii)
names(world)

dim(gii)
dim(world)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
gii2 <- gii %>%
  select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019)

gii2 <- gii2 %>%
  mutate(
    gii_diff = gii_2019 - gii_2010
  )

gii2 <- gii2 %>%
  mutate(
    ISO = countrycode(
      iso3,
      origin = "iso3c",
      destination = "iso2c"
    )
  )
```
```{r}
world_gii <- world %>%
  left_join(gii2, by = "ISO")

head(world_gii)
sum(is.na(world_gii$gii_diff))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
world_gii %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    unmatched = sum(is.na(iso3)),
    missing_gii = sum(!is.na(iso3) & is.na(gii_diff)),
    valid = sum(!is.na(gii_diff))
  )
```
```{r, include=FALSE}
world_gii %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(is.na(gii_diff)) %>%
  select(COUNTRY, ISO, iso3, gii_2010, gii_2019)
```

```{r}
world_gii %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  arrange(gii_diff) %>%
  select(COUNTRY, gii_2010, gii_2019, gii_diff) %>%
head(10)

summary(world_gii$gii_diff)
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")

gii_map <- tm_shape(world_gii) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "gii_diff",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      breaks = c(-0.6, -0.2, -0.1, -0.05, 0, 0.1, 0.3),
      values = "-RdBu",
      value.na = "grey85"
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "GII Change"
    ),
    col = "grey60",
    lwd = 0.3
  ) +
  tm_title(
    "Global Gender Inequality Change (2010–2019)",
    position = tm_pos_out("center", "top")
  ) +
  tm_layout(
    frame = FALSE,
    bg.color = "white"
  )

gii_map
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# Select required columns
world_gii_final <- world_gii %>%
  select(COUNTRY, ISO, gii_2010, gii_2019, gii_diff)

# Check column names
names(world_gii_final)

# Check duplicate names
anyDuplicated(names(world_gii_final))

# Export GeoJSON with a new filename
st_write(
  world_gii_final,
  "Global_GII_Change_Final.geojson",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```
